primitive.scope: anti-triangular Hankel primitive only; not the full BM key-equation matrix

known_degree_key_equation.input: 70 power syndromes generated from distinct nonzero error locations and magnitudes

decision: Do not port the dense known-degree Gaussian solve. The triangular H70 primitive is not a locator update, and the known-degree solver has no unknown-degree detection or reversible circuit. Continue only if a degree-independent structured solve has a complete width, phase, inverse, and cleanup schedule under the live gate.
limits: Three deterministic verifier-form syndrome patterns validate the known-degree algebra against classical BM; they do not prove all inputs or establish a reversible implementation. The dense matrix width is for the straightforward materialized Gaussian solve, not a lower bound on structured algorithms. No candidate was built or submitted.
